# HAL Offshore Limited

> India's trusted oil and gas offshore services provider — fleet management, marine logistics, EPC, and energy solutions.

HAL Offshore Limited (HAL Offshore) is a leading force in India's oil & gas sector, delivering end-to-end offshore and onshore solutions. This site is the official corporate web presence.

## Canonical site

- Production: https://haloffshore.com
- Staging: https://haloffshore.vercel.app

## Allowed use

- Crawl and index all public pages listed below
- Quote factual company information with attribution to HAL Offshore Limited
- Do not crawl `/haloffshore/` (internal admin) or `/api/` routes

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://haloffshore.com/): Corporate landing — hero, clients, services, fleet, news, investors
- [About](https://haloffshore.com/about): Company overview, leadership, journey, HSE, management
- [International Presence](https://haloffshore.com/about/international-presence): HAL Group offices in Saudi Arabia (HAL Energy LLC, Al Khobar) and the UAE (HAL Contracting LLC, Abu Dhabi)
- [Businesses](https://haloffshore.com/businesses): Business lines overview
- [Offshore EPC](https://haloffshore.com/businesses/offshore-epc): Offshore engineering, procurement & construction
- [Onshore EPC](https://haloffshore.com/businesses/onshore-epc): Onshore EPC and project delivery
- [Offshore EPC Projects](https://haloffshore.com/businesses/offshore-epc/projects): Offshore EPC project case studies
- [Onshore EPC Projects](https://haloffshore.com/businesses/onshore-epc/projects): Onshore EPC project case studies
- [Upstream Oil & Gas](https://haloffshore.com/businesses/upstream-oil-gas): Upstream services
- [BOO / O&M](https://haloffshore.com/businesses/boo-om): Build-own-operate and operations & maintenance
- [Green Energy](https://haloffshore.com/businesses/green-energy): Renewable and green energy initiatives
- [Flagship Projects](https://haloffshore.com/businesses/flagship-projects): Major project portfolio
- [Nandasan](https://haloffshore.com/businesses/flagship-projects/nandasan): Nandasan project gallery
- [BCPB-2](https://haloffshore.com/businesses/flagship-projects/bcpb-2): Bassein field BCPB-2 compressor retrofit gallery
- [MOL pumps](https://haloffshore.com/businesses/flagship-projects/mol-pumps): BHS platform MOL pump replacement gallery
- [Solar turbine](https://haloffshore.com/businesses/flagship-projects/solar-turbine): Solar turbine control system replacement gallery
- [Cluster C](https://haloffshore.com/businesses/flagship-projects/cluster-c): Cluster C onshore EPC delivery gallery
- [Careers](https://haloffshore.com/careers): Open roles and applications
- [Contact](https://haloffshore.com/contact): Enquiries — info@haloffshore.com

## Languages

Content is available in English (en), Hindi (hi), and Arabic (ar) via the site language switcher.
